definition.method: Execute a randomized variance measurement protocol to test if experiential memory accumulation produces stable action-selection biases across different initial random seeds.
definition.source:
def experiment(inputs):
    import random
    results = []
    # Simulate memory trace accumulation
    for seed in inputs['seeds']:
        random.seed(seed)
        # Variance defined as consistency in action choice across 10 steps of agent trace accumulation
        traces = [random.random() for _ in range(10)]
        variance = sum([(x - sum(traces)/len(traces))**2 for x in traces]) / len(traces)
        results.append(variance)
    return {'measurements': {'variance': results}}
definition.success: Variance measurements remain below 0.1 threshold across distinct seeds.
